kapre.note: drawn in front of the tree at the tree image top-left + offset; depth = tree depth + small bump. Trees with "leaves": draw that tree-sized leaf overlay right after the kapre at the tree position, so his lower half is tucked into the leaves.

placement.rule: Only one kapre in the whole town. He sits in one random tree out of every placed tree whose prop is listed in "trees". Everyone sees the same tree: pick it from floor(serverTime / hopMinutes) as the seed over the list of those trees sorted by tile, so he hops to a new random tree every hopMinutes with no server state.
